projects.title: Daivio
projects.summary: AI analytics platform built natively for Microsoft Fabric, with LLM workflows, RAG and Azure AI Foundry models. Live in production and published as a Fabric workload.
projects.owned: Backend and API work across the Next.js and Django stack, the Microsoft Fabric integration built on the Fabric Extensibility Toolkit SDK, and the Azure AI Foundry model workflows.
projects.challenge: Making the Fabric integration production-grade: Entra token expiry, session token pollution and load-time race conditions.
projects.result: Resolved all three for production stability; the platform is published as a Microsoft Fabric workload and live at daivio.com.

projects.title: Schoolio.ae
projects.summary: Education discovery platform for the UAE that helps parents compare schools and nurseries.
projects.owned: The full-stack build: Next.js frontend, serverless backend, and the AWS deployment with RDS PostgreSQL.
projects.challenge: Search, filtering and side-by-side comparison across hundreds of institutions, backed by cloud-optimised database queries.

projects.title: Mslm Cloud
projects.summary: Cloud SaaS platform with fine-grained permissions, subscription billing and real-time analytics.
projects.owned: Architected the backend, the SpiceDB permission system and Stripe billing, plus real-time analytics dashboards and REST APIs.
projects.challenge: Fine-grained, per-resource authorisation and subscription billing for enterprise clients on a microservices backend.

projects.title: EzLearn
projects.summary: Subscription learning platform with DRM video streaming, Razorpay payments and AI-generated course roadmaps.
projects.owned: Django and PostgreSQL backend for courses and users, Razorpay subscriptions, VdoCipher DRM video and OpenAI-powered roadmaps; deployed on GCP App Engine and Cloud Run.
projects.challenge: Combining paid subscriptions, protected video and AI-generated learning paths in one product.

projects.title: BidAlert
projects.summary: Automated tender-tracking SaaS for municipal procurement: scrapes and normalises public tender listings, then alerts subscribers to relevant bids as they post.

projects.title: Transform London
projects.summary: Analytics dashboard that pulls Google Analytics and Lighthouse data through a BigQuery ETL pipeline and surfaces performance and traffic insights.
